mentions.name: WhatsApp AI group chat bot
mentions.description: A WhatsApp AI bot for group chats that automates coordination tasks, built for the author's friends' soccer group chat where they organize weekly Wednesday matches. The build process was streamed on YouTube.
mentions.problem: WhatsApp group chats have coordination tasks ripe for automation, and Meta provides little tooling for building WhatsApp bots, unlike Telegram.
mentions.audience: The author's friends' soccer group chat on WhatsApp; group chats whose members (the author notes Hispanic users) rely on WhatsApp
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a WhatsApp AI bot for my group chats, specifically for my friends' soccer group chat where we organize our Wednesday matches.

evidence.value: I'm working on a WhatsApp AI bot for my group chats, specifically for my friends' soccer group chat where we organize our Wednesday matches.
